verdicts.reason: Both are near-identical 320x50 banners. The orange headline sits on the left, and the body copy, tagline, dashed divider and booking/URL text are crammed into a column on the right at about 4–5px. That text is unreadable, there is no clear CTA, and the dividers are just clutter. A edges ahead because its 'Traditional Ceramics / Workshop' headline is larger and anchors the hierarchy better. B breaks it 'Traditional / Ceramics Workshop' at a smaller size, which makes it weaker. B's right column is no more legible than A's.
